This Writ Petition has been filed seeking for issuance of a mandamus, to to direct the respondents 2 and 3 to make the reference, under Section 20(1) of Tamil Nadu Highways Act to the appropriate Court as per the representation sent by the petitioner dated 22.03.2019 with reference to the issue of enhancement of compensation in respect of the petitioner lands in New S.No.190/36 and 190/35 measuring 1427 sq.mtr, Sriperumpudur Taluk, Kancheepuram District.
2 . T h e c a s e o f t h e p e t i t i o n e r i s t h a t o r i g i n a l l y t h e p r o p e r t y i s s i t u a t e d a t
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis S.No.190/28 (49/1A3), New S.Nos.190/36 and 190/35 measuring to an extent of 4050 sq.mtr which was purchased by the petitioner's grandfather

. After his lifetime,
it devolved upon the petitioner's father.
After the demise of his father, the property devolved on the legal heirs of T.Jayaraman.

The said property was divided by metes and bounds through a Registered Partition Deed dated 04.12.2003 and thus being the legal heirs of T.Jayaraman, the petitioner and his brother J.Sridhar became the owner of 75 cents and 25 cents respectively out of one acre in S.No.49/3, Oragadam Village.

From and out of the 75 cents of land allotted to the petitioner under the partition deed, the Highways Department vide Notification dated 09.08.2017 sought to acquire 1427 sq.mts (i.e 942 sq.mtr in S.No.190/36 and 485 sq.mtr in S.No.190/35) under Section 15(2) of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act.

Subsequent to the Notification under Section 15(2)
of the Act, the petitioner did not received any communication from the respondents herein in respect of the said acquisition under Act 34 of 2002.
3. The petitioner had received a communication dated 07.01.2019 issued by the fourth respondent under Sections 19(5) and 19(7) of the Act.
The petitioner had attended the meeting before the third respondent on 25.01.2019.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
The second and fourth respondents have explained the necessity and the public purpose under which the acquisition is sought for.
The petitioner agreed to give his consent, but demanded for proper valuation of his lands.

sentences.text: On 28.02.2019/01.03.2019, the fourth respondent passed an Award.
In view of the request of the respondents, the petitioner received the compensation under protest with a request for reference of the matter under Section 20 of the Act, on 22.03.2019.
The respondents paid the compensation to the petitioner through Cheque dated 28.08.2019 and the same was handed over to the petitioner on 13.09.2019.
He has also received a notice on 20.09.2019 seeking to handover the area of land under acquisition.

5. Since the compensation amount paid to the petitioner is not in accordance with the present prevailing market value, and that the respondents are ignoring to make a reference, as requested to the petitioner under Section 20 of the Act.

He caused a legal notice seeking either to accept the return of compensation paid or in the alternative to make a reference as per the petitioner's representation dated 22.03.2019, as prescribed under Section 20 of the Act.
After receipt of the notice, the fourth respondent replied stating that the compensation amount paid cannot be received back.
Hence, the writ petition.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 6.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Government Pleader for the respondents.

7. A status report was filed by the fourth respondent dated 30.01.2020, wherein, it is mentioned that necessary proposal has been submitted in his office Lr.No.27/2017 dated 24.01.2020 to the first respondent referring the matter to the concerned Sub Court.
But, till now, the first respondent has not passed any order for referring the matter before the appropriate Court.

8. Considering the above facts and circumstances of the case, the second and third respondents are directed to make a reference under Section 20(1) of the Act to the appropriate Court as per the representation of the petitioner dated 22.03.2019 with reference to the issue of enhancement of compensation in respect of the petitioner's land in S.Nos.190/35 and 190/36 measuring an extent of 1427 sq.mtr at Oragadam Village, Sriperumbudur Taluk, Kancheepuram District, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
